faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Trainee post at IIT Gandhinagar is 19 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Trainee post at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Trainee post in the IIT Gandhinagar recruitment drive. This opportunity is for individuals meeting the specified educational qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Gandhinagar Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Gandhinagar Trainee recruitment is Online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official website of IIT Gandhinagar within the stipulated time frame.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Trainee position at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The salary for the Trainee position at IIT Gandhinagar ranges from ₹ 18,000/- to ₹ 32,000/- per month. This compensation will be provided to selected candidates as per the terms of the contractual employment.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Trainee post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma (03 years duration) after 12th in an appropriate discipline. Specific percentage requirements for 10th, 12th, and graduation are also mentioned in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Gandhinagar Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Gandhinagar Trainee recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any charges.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the IIT Gandhinagar Trainee recruitment can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the application process and eligibility.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Trainee position?
faq.answer: The Trainee position at IIT Gandhinagar is a Contractual job type. This means the employment will be for a specified period, as outlined in the official recruitment notification.

faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is https://www.iitgn.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to access the online application portal.
